7/20.02.2023 I. A. No. 5742 of 2022 (in Cr. Appeal Db No. 587 of 2022):
Heard Mr. Prashant Kumar Rahul, learned counsel appearing for the appellant and
Mrs. Priya Shrestha, learned Special P.P. appearing for the State.

This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to
him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 376(D), 323 & 341 of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 25 years along with a fine of Rs. 25,000/- for the offence under Section 376 (D) I.P.C.
It has been alleged that the appellant and other accused persons had committed rape upon the victim.

sentences.text: 1 The victim has been examined as P.W. 1 who has supported the allegations levelled against the appellant.
The DNA profiling of the appellant and the victim has also matched.
In view of the above, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the appellant is rejected.
I. A. No. 5742 of 2022 stands rejected.
